selection_basis: Native RGB target-white-surface versus dark-background outer boundary; full RGB and unaltered crops inspected before extraction.
edge_method: At each individual native x, take largest downward one-row luminance step in fixed search strip; measure local bright/dark medians from rows j-5..j-2 and j+3..j+6; solve native-pixel 50% local-contrast crossing within j-2..j+2. No cross-column smoothing, interpolation, extrapolation, or sparse-anchor interpolation.
release_rule: Reject failed columns, endpoint guards, points touching a 3px dilation of old valid or within Chebyshev 6px of old points; retain all old points in exact order. New valid is only a +/-8px vertical ribbon around individually accepted RGB edge, clipped to reviewed search strip and crop guards, minus old-domain/old-point neighborhoods; union with unchanged old valid.
exclusions: No crop-edge or hidden/occluded target extrapolation
E1/U1 left structures outside reviewed local domain
E2 detached upper rod outside reviewed local domain
E3 internal surface shadow outside reviewed local domain
No other rectangle or camera/frame is released
